title: PDF Wavelet Projections for Volume Rendering
abstract:

First, instead of interpolation-based wavelet splatting, we use wavelet splats that are optimal in the least-square sense, hence better quality. Second, the computation of the projection is done on a grid whose sampling step size adapts to the size of the basis function. This gives an addi-tional speed-up at coarse resolutions.
